body:
V13.1 Configuration Documentation

> This section provides documentation requriements around how the application communicates with external services and how techniques which should be employed to prevent loss of availability due to these services not being accessible.

Do we want to limit it to external services?

---

V13.2 Backend Communication Configuration

Maybe the section text should mention related "Secure Communication" chapter and clarify the focus, what is in this section and what is in the V12.

---

V13.4 Build and Deploy

> Whilst the security of build processes and the DevSecOps aspects involved are generally not in scope for ASVS, this section captures security controls for the application itself, which are applied at the build and deploy process, such as how the application is compiled and avoiding unnecessary content when the application is deployed.

"which are applied" is a bit strong I think, "can be applied", "are usually applied"?

---

13.4

> Compliance with this section requires an automated build system, and access to build and deployment scripts.

Does it? The point for ASVS is, that you can verify everything with full access to the application without having access to CI/CD or other environments.

Most likely leftover from v4.0.3 content.

---

13.5

> If these issues are not present by default, it raises the bar for attacking an application, and it may encourage the attacker to look for easier targets.

I would remove the ", and it may encourage the attacker to look for easier targets". Or entire quoted sentence.
